Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

Map customer processes into agentic workflows: decide what the agent decides, what a tool does, and where a human stays in the loop

Stay up to date with the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and help us decide what is production-ready and what is not

Proven experience building LLM-based applications that reached production, not only prototypes and demos

Experience working against AI and LLM APIs from several providers, including tool and function calling, structured output, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) or comparable ways of exposing tools and data to an agent
Full-stack capability: you can take a solution from user interface through backend services, databases, APIs and authentication to a running deployment
Docker and containers as part of your normal way of working, together with CI/CD and monitoring

Ability to work directly with customers, translate ambiguous requirements into something buildable, and explain trade-offs in plain language
Working proficiency in English; Finnish is a strong advantage in customer work

Local and self-hosted inference

Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. We are expanding our platform team with a Test Engineer who owns the quality of that backbone.

You are the quality owner of the platform itself, not of the screens in front of it. Your working level is services, APIs, messages and data: does a domain service behave as its contract promises, does a telemetry value survive ingestion, aggregation and retrieval unchanged, and does any of it still hold at the scale of a global fleet. You work in an agile team of developers, architects and product owners, following and sharpening our platform testing standard
so that quality is a property of how we build, not a phase at the end. The total platform team is 14 people.

Test automation here is real engineering. Our suites are written in C# on .NET
by the same standards as the product code: xUnit, Testcontainers
to spin up Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse per run, .NET Aspire
to bring up the distributed application, and a shared helper library published as a NuGet package so every service team tests against the same building blocks. Suites run in Azure DevOps
pipelines per component and per environment, reporting into Xray
.

Your first months land in the middle of a platform generation change, with two generations running side by side while we migrate. It is a demanding start and the fastest way to learn the platform inside out, but it is not the whole job: the migration will finish, the platform will keep growing, and so will your scope.

In This Role, You Will

Test the platform where it lives: contract, schema and integration testing of domain services and APIs, message and event flows, and the persistence behind them.
Validate the data, not just the code: event streams, time-series and aggregated telemetry, from the message a device sends to the value the platform serves to its consumers.
Extend the shared test framework the other service teams build on, and keep those suites running as quality gates in CI/CD rather than by hand.
Solve testability as a design problem. Where a service cannot be validated on its own, work out what is needed (governed test data, stubs, simulators, contract tests, observability) and get it into the backlog before the feature is built, instead of testing on production machines.
Hold the platform to what it promises its consumers. The portal, the mobile apps and internal consumers depend on your services, so you own those contracts and work with those teams on the flows that cross the boundary.
Cover performance and load at fleet scale, through harnesses that drive the real processing pipeline rather than a simplified copy of it.
Prove migrations and domain transitions: dual-source comparison between old and new, backward compatibility per domain, and confidence at cutover.
Shape quality upstream and after the fact: turn requirements into test cases during refinement, challenge anything that cannot be verified, and triage defects across service boundaries.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Solid grounding in testing methodology, QA practice and defect analysis: functional, regression and risk-based testing.

Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something is not testable as specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

Professional level of English, able to collaborate with international teams – your day‑to‑day work will be in English.

Design, build, and maintain Python‑based AI agents using modern agentic frameworks and cloud AI runtimes.
Develop and maintain .NET Core APIs that act as downstream services for the AI agent layer.
Build and integrate Angular micro frontends and Stencil web components into an existing enterprise shell application.

Write and maintain Terraform code to define and manage cloud infrastructure for the platform.

Collaborate closely with frontend, backend, AI, and infrastructure teams to deliver end‑to‑end features.
Implement and enforce security and compliance best practices across the stack (identity, auditability, PII redaction, feature flags, etc.).
Contribute to technical design documentation, READMEs, and the team knowledge base, helping to spread best practices and onboard new team members.

Strong problem‑solving skills and analytical thinking, with the ability to understand complex business and technical domains (payroll, HR, compliance).
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in multidisciplinary teams (engineering, architecture, product, operations, business stakeholders).
Proactive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and focus on continuous improvement and automation.
Comfortable working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban), participating in ceremonies and contributing to team rituals.

Experience in financial services, payroll, HR tech or other highly regulated sectors.
Experience with event‑driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
Experience with DevSecOps tools (SAST, DAST, dependency analysis, secrets management).
Familiarity with observability and reliability practices (monitoring, logging, alerting, SRE concepts).
Experience with API gateways, service mesh, or service discovery tools.

Career growth: 70% of our senior leaders started in junior positions.
Continuous learning: access to our Technology Academy, Udemy courses, webinars, and company‑funded certifications.
Flexibility: remote work options, flexible working policies, and social benefits (meal vouchers, transport, childcare support, private health insurance, etc.).
Well‑being: our WeCare program supports employees in critical situations.
Personal development: annual training budget to boost both your hard and soft skills.

Who are we?

Amaris Consulting, part of Mantu is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Brief Call

Interviews

We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!

Case study

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.

We look forward to meeting you!
